title: Endless Worlds is a mmorpg I have been working on
author: Trexaty92
selftext:
Endless worlds is an mmorpg I have been working on that is heavily inspired by a game I grew up playing, it is more of a passion project than anything else.

Everything ai generated from the website to the server to the assets.. this has been basically building itself on the side while I work full time.

Its time for dev update #1 

\*\*Trades\*\*  
🎣 Fishing  
⛏️ Mining   
🪓 Woodcutting  
\+ In game interactive guide featuring resource and gear requirements, locations and other valuable information.

\*\*Pets\*\*  
🐕‍🦺 🐙   Follow you, Wander around you, Pick up your drops..

\*\*Mounts\*\*  
🐺 🐢  Swimming and on Land 

\*\*Global Map\*\*  
🗺️ An overview of the world rich with information like monster levels, shops, resources and more.

\*\*Revamped Central City\*\*  
🌇  The Starting City has had a makeover, a cosy harbour city with ships and many npcs to interact with.

\*\*New Maps\*\*  
\- Copper Mines, a cave filled with bats, multi level platforms and waterfalls.. also beginner level ores.  
\- Forest Crypt, a crypt filled with skeletons, an elite world boss and a unique ore to mine.

\*\*Fixes\*\*  
\- Walking animations have been revamped.  
\- Attacking animations have been revamped.  
\- UI has been revamped.  
\- Skill and balancing refinements.  
\-  Shadow Refinements, more tiles and objects added and refined for better quality and minor fixes.
